# Independent preparation review of the policy driver

The final reviewed driver is `afc8c47b730b432fd0672d6e5adc3dcfa51d76b8d72d2953368fde54fe825f9f`; its README is `35e0c39aec9fcc432ee29c04235081f29476d9ae93825c63ac5e6bed86574f8a`. No blocking defect remains for a root-reviewed prospective freeze and subsequent explicitly delegated execution. This review did not import or execute the driver, any checker/build/test, mdBook, CLI or native process, and changed no active source, documentation or metadata.

I found an actual abort-reporting defect in the retained first draft: `pool.map` may raise while other submitted jobs launch/save logs, so in-memory `len(records)` was not an actual launched-command count. Root authorized the narrow repair. The exact retained before/after patch and six-member archive map verify that only the wrapper-aborted branch now enumerates saved per-command JSON record files and reports actual launches as null/unknown. It does not assert those records complete. Startup rejection's zero and successful17-command accounting are unchanged. Failure provenance stays in `repair-01`; no prior result/map was rewritten.

The17 commands are literal source: pinned mdBook version, owned temporary build, generated HTML/print local links/anchors, then fourteen fixed Python checks. No recorded argv selects a command. Regression expectations12/7/11/36/17/14 sum to97 and match current authored test definitions; only genuine successful unittest stderr may supply eventual observed counts. Schema is explicitly source-only and corpus has no binary, so neither branch performs theorem replay or algorithm execution. Two-worker jobs inspect live inputs or mutate only their private regression temporaries. Docs/edition/constitution/inventory/coverage checks have no write flags.

Prerequisites require explicit hashes of complete nine-stage latest/MSRV terminal results, before/after input-map equality, recomputed source-map digest, successful stage flags and raw hashes, real1.98.1/1.85.0 version text, current executable-source identities and every current production Rust path. Historical latest CLI bytes may differ from current MSRV CLI; the current executable must match the actual MSRV rebuild and original-source capture. The capture map verifies its complete member inventory, operationally complete72 observations, raw/journal identities, actual aggregate exits/counts and final/prospective identity. CLI nonzero semantic checks remain observations, not policy failures; native rows remain pre-execv attempts rather than independently authenticated process starts/exits.

The actual existing packets match those field schemas: latest/MSRV attempt09 each have nine successful stages and284 passing bounded tests with the same760-row source digest. The final365-member original capture records72 observations,26 success/46 nonzero exits and260 forwarded attempts. I audited their maps/raw associations by reading/hashing; this is separate root evidence, not execution by the reviewer or proof that the source oracle is independent.

The prospective scan guards all active inventory sources/current production Rust plus scripts/book/governance/rules/std/corpus provenance/tests and selected current unit packets. Proposal archives/relocations/`.md.txt` copies are current hashed bytes; historical member-map paths are never treated as obsolete live-path requirements. Own policy output/temporary rendering is excluded. Runtime checks compare the complete selected inventory, binaries, reviewed map and prerequisites before/after; they do not attest every transient input access or all external environment/dependency state. Root must freeze only after its applied metadata/docs and final terminal capture are stable.

Version checking precedes mdBook build; the actual fixed binary must report exactly0.5.4. The book destination is one newly owned `/private/tmp` tree, mapped before removing only that tree. HTML and print local href/src/anchors are checked without fetching external URLs; CSS imports/dynamic JavaScript are outside that checker. Each command has a180-second deadline and1MiB retained stream prefixes; timeout, overflow, launch failure or incomplete known cleanup forbids a pass. These limits do not impose a generated-book disk-byte quota. Generated bytes are measured/mapped and cleaned; process-group cleanup is not an all-descendant provenance guarantee.

Successful policy status additionally requires every17 record complete, all exact97 regressions, rendered-book counts, unchanged inputs/binaries/map and revalidated prerequisites. Incomplete stages or exceptions retain failed/partial records and cannot supply that status. Ordinary policy success would not be fresh Lean replay, source/native/compiler preservation, exact family proof, canonical std/QFT exposure, constitutional adoption/discharge, full CI, release approval or Issue closure. I authored earlier finite/lexical/concrete and first-source/capture work, but not this root-authored policy driver or D's narrow repair; this review is independent of those changes, not an independent oracle for my own implementation.
